title: Infrastructure Overview
description: All Windows and Linux servers: health, CPU, memory, disk

panels.title: Servers UP
panels.query: count((max by (host) (last_over_time(up{agent="observaone",job=~"windows|linux"}[120s])) or max by (host) (up{job=~"windows|linux",agent!="observaone"})) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Servers DOWN
panels.query: count((max by (host) (last_over_time(up{agent="observaone",job=~"windows|linux"}[120s])) or max by (host) (up{job=~"windows|linux",agent!="observaone"})) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Average CPU
panels.query: avg(clamp(max by (host) (last_over_time(observaone_cpu_utilization_ratio[120s])) * 100, 0, 100) or (clamp(100 * (1 - sum by (host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle",core!=""}[5m])) / sum by (host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{core!=""}[5m]))), 0, 100) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle",core!=""})) > time() - 120)) or (clamp(100 * (1 - sum by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",agent_id=""}[5m])) / sum by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{agent_id=""}[5m]))), 0, 100) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",agent_id=""})) > time() - 120)))

panels.title: Average memory
panels.query: avg(max by (host) (100 * last_over_time(observaone_memory_utilization_ratio[120s])) or (max by (host) (100 * (1 - windows_memory_available_bytes / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes)) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(windows_memory_available_bytes)) > time() - 120)) or (max by (host) (100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{agent_id=""} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{agent_id=""})) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{agent_id=""})) > time() - 120)))

panels.title: CPU used by server
panels.query: clamp(max by (host) (last_over_time(observaone_cpu_utilization_ratio[120s])) * 100, 0, 100) or (clamp(100 * (1 - sum by (host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle",core!=""}[5m])) / sum by (host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{core!=""}[5m]))), 0, 100) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle",core!=""})) > time() - 120)) or (clamp(100 * (1 - sum by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",agent_id=""}[5m])) / sum by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{agent_id=""}[5m]))), 0, 100) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",agent_id=""})) > time() - 120))

panels.title: Memory used by server
panels.query: max by (host) (100 * last_over_time(observaone_memory_utilization_ratio[120s])) or (max by (host) (100 * (1 - windows_memory_available_bytes / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes)) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(windows_memory_available_bytes)) > time() - 120)) or (max by (host) (100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{agent_id=""} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{agent_id=""})) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{agent_id=""})) > time() - 120))

panels.title: Lowest disk free by server
panels.query: min by (host) (100 * (1 - last_over_time(observaone_filesystem_utilization_ratio{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|nsfs|fuse.*"}[120s]))) or (min by (host) (100 * windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"})) > time() - 120)) or (min by (host) (100 * node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|nsfs|fuse.*",agent_id=""} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|nsfs|fuse.*",agent_id=""}) and on (host) (max by (host) (timestamp(node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs|ramfs|nsfs|fuse.*",agent_id=""})) > time() - 120))
